title: Scaling RAG QA with Large Docs, Tables, and 30K+ Chunks (No LangChain)

I'm facing a few specific challenges: 30K+ total chunks across all docs → KNN retrieval gets noisy. Tried LLM-based reranking, but it's too slow and expensive to run on all 30K chunks. Table chunks are especially difficult: Embeddings perform poorly on structured/numeric data. Summary-style embeddings (e.g. first 300 tokens, or using just heading/caption) aren’t sufficient for value-level lookups.
